violation_type.title: Documentation for Directors - Submit with New Application (26 TAC §744.1037(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Documentation for Directors - Submit with New Application
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not notify licensing of change of site director.     The caregiver was present during the inspection. There were no director credentials on file.
